placeName.en: Olympic Valley to Auburn, California, USA

note.zh-CN: 2026 届启用新线；旧线数据不再代表当前赛道，本页按 2026 官方赛道页记录。
note.en: A new course was used in 2026; the earlier course no longer represents the current route, and this page records the official 2026 course page.

details.direction: Point-to-point from Olympic Valley to Placer High School in Auburn
details.distanceMethod: Official course pages give 100.2 miles; no metric distance is published. 100.2 miles converts to 161,256 m (161.3 km), which is the figure used on this card. No alternate official distance figure exists.
details.elevationMethod: Official Course Description gives 2,550 ft of climb in the first 4.5 miles plus another 15,540 ft, a summed total of 18,090 ft; the home page rounds this to more than 18,000 ft and the descent to nearly 23,000 ft. This card uses the exact summed climb, 18,090 ft = 5,514 m. The official pages do not publish per-segment gain or loss.
details.attribution: Western States Endurance Run Foundation. The official GPS Info page links only WSER2027.gpx (HEAD 200, 538,087 bytes, 22 waypoints, 6,000 trackpoints, creator GPS Visualizer). The file was downloaded once to a temporary directory, measured locally and deleted: planar distance 161.23 km against 100.2 mi = 161.256 km; at a 1 m threshold +5,537 / −7,012 m against the official 18,090 / 22,970 ft = 5,513.8 / 7,001.3 m; maximum 2,651 m against Emigrant Pass 8,750 ft = 2,666.7 m. The file's own desc lists five changes from 2026: Shirley lift top by road, a new five-mile trail in Granite Chief, a Duncan Canyon exit change, Little Bald instead of N43, and an adjustment before Cal-1. It is therefore an official 2027 entry, not the 2026 raced geometry. No copyright line and no redistribution licence: linked only, not hosted, mirrored or redrawn.
